title: Ship a JWT-authenticated staging API
goal: Deploy a staging API at api.staging.example.com with JWT auth behind TLS
context: Greenfield service; no staging infra exists yet. Team of 3, 2-week window.
constraints: Must pass security review before merge
assumptions: DNS for staging.example.com is already delegated
Team has admin access to the cloud account
Company SSO can issue JWTs via standard OIDC

steps.action: Backup/snapshot current cloud config and create staging subnet
steps.rationale: Isolate blast radius; allow clean rollback
steps.verify: Subnet exists; snapshot ID recorded; rollback dry-run succeeds

steps.action: Scaffold service and Dockerfile; add /healthz endpoint
steps.rationale: Smallest deployable unit proves the pipeline end-to-end

steps.action: Wire JWT validation middleware (OIDC, pinned issuer, short clock skew)
steps.rationale: Auth is the highest-risk surface; do it before anything user-facing
steps.verify: Expired/forged/tampered tokens all rejected with 401; audit log entry written

steps.action: Provision TLS via managed cert; deploy behind load balancer
steps.rationale: TLS terminates secrets in transit; managed certs kill a whole failure class
steps.verify: curl -v shows valid cert chain; HTTP→HTTPS redirect works

steps.action: Run smoke tests + authz matrix; security review; then cut over DNS
steps.rationale: Gate traffic until positive and negative tests pass; review catches blind spots
steps.verify: All smoke tests green; review sign-off; synthetic user completes login flow

risks.description: JWT validation flaw lets forged tokens through
risks.mitigation: Pinned issuer + JWKS cache with short TTL; mandatory pen-test of auth middleware before cutover
Single IaC repo; CI check that staging plan is a pure superset of prod

success_criteria: Signed-in smoke test passes with a real OIDC token
